Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on characterizing N-glycosylation sites of Mayaro virus proteins E1 and E2. The proteomics workflow uses DDA and specific enzymatic treatments (PNGase F and Endo H) to identify glycosylation sites via deamidation or remnant sugar detection. A separate glycan-only analysis was performed using procainamide labeling, but the protein-level analysis is the primary proteomics assay.
